scope: Diagnostic sensitivity only; H2-01 still requires the original full 64-case gate.
saturation_ratio_meaning: Reporting bin near the actual cone boundary, not an acceptance gate or physical parameter.

trials.name: baseline
trials.rationale: Repeat the original strong-loop input exactly; all previous metrics must match.

trials.name: half_dt
trials.rationale: Halve integration step, retaining a 2 ms telemetry interval.

trials.name: quarter_dt
trials.rationale: Quarter integration step, retaining a 2 ms telemetry interval.

trials.name: iterations400
trials.rationale: Test the Newton iteration cap; record actual counts and unchanged built-in tolerance.

trials.name: elliptic
trials.rationale: Change friction-cone model only; this is not a pure numerical-convergence setting.

trials.name: elliptic_impratio100
trials.rationale: Increase tangential-to-normal impedance relative to the elliptic trial; coefficient of friction unchanged.

trials.name: elliptic_impratio100_noslip3
trials.rationale: Add three NoSlip sweeps; retain energy audit and any instabilities.

trials.name: long6
trials.rationale: Report each whole cycle separately; never replace the original short-window acceptance result.

comparison_rule: Report every named trial and error, native metrics, original findings, per-cycle values, all-step decomposition, iteration counts and cone utilization. No best-case-only reporting.
raw_data: All integration-step numeric rows retained; verbose contact JSON sampled at each Scenario record_every cadence.

sources.summary: Soft contact can drift inside the friction cone; elliptic/impratio/NoSlip affect the model and can introduce costs or instability.

limits: No real-world validation or independent dynamics solver in this study.
Step convergence cannot validate the contact-model assumptions.
Longer cycles cannot erase the prescribed original-window result.
